mapper.insert: INSERT INTO diet_user_memory ( user_id, memory_type, memory_key, memory_value, strength, evidence_count, source, last_session_id, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{memoryType}, #{memoryKey}, #{memoryValue}, #{strengthDelta}, 1, #{source}, #{sessionId}, NOW(), NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE strength = GREATEST(-10, LEAST(10, strength + VALUES(strength))), evidence_count = evidence_count + 1, source = VALUES(source), last_session_id = VALUES(last_session_id), updated_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, memory_type, memory_key, memory_value, strength, evidence_count, source, last_session_id, created_at, updated_at FROM diet_user_memory WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND memory_type = 'SLOT_PREFERENCE' AND strength > 0 ORDER BY strength DESC, updated_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, user_id, memory_type, memory_key, memory_value, strength, evidence_count, source, last_session_id, created_at, updated_at FROM diet_user_memory WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND memory_type = 'MEAL_PREFERENCE' AND strength < 0 ORDER BY strength ASC, updated_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, user_id, memory_type, memory_key, memory_value, strength, evidence_count, source, last_session_id, created_at, updated_at FROM diet_user_memory WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND strength > 0 ORDER BY strength DESC, updated_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM diet_user_memory WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND memory_type = 'SLOT_PREFERENCE'
